stories.title: Meta Agrees to $18 Billion Settlement Over Child Addiction Claims
stories.summary: Meta will pay $18 billion to settle lawsuits that claim its platforms hooked children on social media. The deal follows mid-trial settlement talks between Meta and several states. Meta is also still in talks with the EU over addictive design features on its apps.
stories.whyItMatters: The settlement removes a major legal overhang for Meta and could set a template for how other platforms handle child-safety litigation.
whatToWatch: Final court approval of the settlement terms
Outcome of Meta's separate talks with EU regulators
Whether other social media firms face similar suits
questions: How will the $18 billion be distributed among plaintiffs?
Will the EU talks lead to new product changes or fines?
